name: dual_infeasible_diag
description: 2x2 SDP: max <I,X> = tr X s.t. X_12 = 0 (encoded as <A_1,X> = 2*X_12 = 0), X >= 0. The primal is UNBOUNDED (the diagonal of X is free, so tr X -> +infinity), which means the DUAL is infeasible. The solver reports DUAL_INFEASIBLE directly. Distinct from the 'unbounded'-tagged cases: here the objective is the full trace and the single constraint is an off-diagonal pin.
witness: Recession ray Xhat = E_11: <A_1,Xhat> = 0 (A_1 = [[0,1],[1,0]], so <A_1,Xhat> = 2*Xhat_12 = 0), <C,Xhat> = 1 > 0 (C = I), Xhat >= 0 (eigs 1,0). Primal unboundedness along Xhat certifies dual infeasibility.
